Subject: Post-demo recap & proposed POC plan (success criteria, owners, timeline)

Hi Samira / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time to demo with us this morning - appreciate the thoughtful questions. As promised, below is a concise post-call recap and a proposed 3-week POC/trial plan so your team can validate both quality and performance before committing to dedicated capacity.

High-level goals (what success looks like):
- Quality: >= 85% NPS on 150 sample prompts across the 3 major user flows (support triage, Knowledge Base Q&A, automated summarization).
- Latency: 95th percentile <= 450ms for single-turn chat under expected traffic profile (burst to 20 TPS).
- Integration: SDK-based routing with streaming enabled; tool-calling support for retrieval across internal KB.
- Security: Data handling in VPC mode (no customer data persisted beyond transient KV cache), SOC2 evidence provided.

Proposed POC timeline & ownership:
- Week 0 (this week): Confirm success criteria, identify engineering owners, and share access (API keys, test accounts). Owner: Marissa
- Week 1 (integration): Instrument SDK, wire up chat routes, enable streaming and test tool-calling. Owner: Dev Patel (integration lead) + Tom (Acme eng)
- Week 2 (evaluation): Run eval set, collect latency/cost metrics via Redwood Console, iterate on prompts & batch settings. Owner: Ethan Park + Acme QA
- Week 3 (finalize): Lock config, provide handoff doc and recommendation (quantization/profile / autoscale settings). Owner: Marissa + Dev

Immediate next steps (please confirm):
1) Confirm success criteria above or share edits by EOD Wed (2026-03-31).
2) Introduce a primary engineering contact (if Tom isn't the main owner) so we can schedule the Week 1 kickoff.
3) Accept the attached POC plan (acme-poc-plan.pdf) and we'll send a calendar invite for Thu 10:00 AM PT for a 30-min engineering kickoff.

Implementation notes (brief):
- Recommended integration: Redwood JS/py SDK to start (we'll include example snippets).
- Streaming: use server-sent events (SSE) or SDK streaming client - reduces perceived latency and supports partial tokens for real-time UI.
- Tool calling: we support structured function calling; recommend starting with retrieval-as-a-tool using your KB endpoint.

I've attached a short POC plan and sample prompt set. Happy to jump on another call if you want a live pairing session with your engineers.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

--

Hi Samira / Tom - great questions, answered inline below and added an implementation checklist for your engineers.

1) Streaming & SDK
- JS SDK: yes - it supports streaming tokens (EventSource under the hood for browser; Node streaming client for server). Use the chat completions stream for interactive UIs. Example SDK call:

// JS SDK streaming pseudocode
const stream = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-medium', messages: [{role: 'user', content: 'Summarize...'}] });
for await (const chunk of stream) { renderChunk(chunk.delta); }

- Endpoints recommendation:
  - Streaming (interactive UIs): POST /v1/chat/stream or SDK.stream helper (SSE/websocket)
  - Non-streaming (batch jobs / offline): POST /v1/chat/completions (non-streaming)

2) Tool calling (retrieval-as-a-tool)
- Pattern: implement a function schema (name: 'kb_retrieve', parameters: {query, top_k}) and call your KB service from within your middleware. The model returns a function call object we translate into a KB API call and then return results as a subsequent model input.
- Recommended limits: keep function payloads under ~8KB to avoid token inflation; retrieve top_k=5 by default and truncate long documents on ingest.
- Example function schema (JSON) and handling is in the attached POC doc.

3) Security & retention
- KV caches: transient by default; not persisted to disk across sessions unless you opt into a cache store. We can run the POC in a VPC tenant - we'll provision a temporary VPC test env for you.
- SOC2 evidence: attaching SOC2 summary and I'll introduce our security lead in the kickoff.

Implementation checklist (engineering kickoff deliverables)
- Onboard devs to Redwood account + create API key (Marissa)
- Install SDK and run hello-world streaming example (Dev)
- Wire chat route and example tool-calling stub to KB (Tom + Dev)
- Run evaluation harness (Ethan) and share metric dashboard link

Sample curl for chat streaming (server-side chunking example):

curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-medium","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize Q1 notes"}],"stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat/completions

I've attached a one-pager with the recommended API routes and a sample function-calling flow. We will handle provisioning a VPC test tenant and share SOC2 artifacts during kickoff. Looking forward to Thu 10am PT.

Best,
Marissa

Internal - copying the two of you to align on ownership and immediate tasks for the Thu 10am PT kickoff with Acme (Samira / Tom). Please do not forward this internal note.

Priority items before the kickoff:
- Dev: please prepare the JS and Python SDK streaming examples and a short README we can drop into the kickoff slides. Focus on the chat.stream() pattern and an example of handling partial tokens.
- Ethan: stand up the eval harness with the 150-sample prompt set in the attached doc and prepare dashboard (latency/cost/quality).
- I will provision a VPC test tenant and request SOC2 artifacts from security.

Sample API route mapping for the integration (for Dev):
- POST /v1/chat/completions (non-streaming) - batch eval jobs
- POST /v1/chat/stream (streaming) - interactive UI, SSE chunks with token deltas
- POST /v1/tools/kb_retrieve (internal) - lookup wrapper for retrieval-as-tool; returns JSON array of docs

Minimal sample request body (chat stream):
{
  "model": "redwood-medium",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content": "Find the onboarding steps for ROI tracking"}],
  "stream": true,
  "max_tokens": 512
}

Edge cases / notes:
- If we see token inflation during the eval, reduce top_k on retrieval and enable summarization on ingest.
- For initial runs use single-threaded client to validate correctness before increasing concurrency.

Can one of you confirm you're assigned to these by EOD? I'll send the calendar invite once confirmed.

Thanks,
Marissa
